title: Join Leave Vanish
description: Customize join, leave, and vanish messages with ease.
body:
🟦 JoinLeaveVanish

A lightweight and fully configurable plugin for join, leave, and vanish systems on your Minecraft server.

JoinLeaveVanish adds a powerful and flexible messaging and vanish system for Paper/Spigot servers. Customize join and leave messages, welcome new players with a first-join message, and use a fully functional vanish system with sounds, TAB control, and permissions.

⚙️ Features

✨ Fully customizable messages

Edit join, leave, and welcome messages
Supports both MiniMessage and legacy color codes (&)
Prefix system for consistent styling across all messages

🎉 Welcome system

Custom message for first-time players joining the server
Perfect for greetings or server introductions

👻 Vanish system (/vanish, /v)

Completely hide players from others
Optional removal from TAB list
Permission-based visibility (joinleavevanish.seevanish)
Fake join/leave messages when toggling vanish

🔊 Sound support

Custom sounds when enabling/disabling vanish
Fully configurable or optional

🔐 Permissions & control

Simple permission-based system
Prevent unauthorized vanish usage

⚡ Reload without restart

Reload configuration instantly using /joinleave reload
🧩 Highlights
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Easy YAML configuration
Modern chat formatting with MiniMessage support
Perfect for Survival, CityBuild, or RPG servers
💬 Example
[Server] ➜ Jonas joined the server.
[Server] ➜ Jonas left the server.

Vanish example:

You are now invisible.
